messages:
danielle: Quick heads-up I have a team member (Luca) who observes a regional holiday on 2026-12-29 but our global year-end freeze is 12/24-12/31. Hed like to swap that day to 2027-01-05 to cover an interview panel. Can we do a one-off swap and how do we record it?

pranav: You can do a one-off swap if manager signs off and it's recorded before the blackout cutoff. Use the Time-off Adjustment form in People Portal. Make sure to add a coverage note.

sophie: Adding: if the swap is because of interview coverage, ping #recruiting so we can reassign panels. Also mention if this affects any on-call or support rotations.

danielle: Manager approved via email. Two administrative Qs: 1) Is there any payroll consequence if this moves hours into the next accrual period? 2) Does the swap count as "scheduled" for blackout rules once filed?

pranav: 1) If the move causes accruals to exceed the carryover cap, you need to select "carryover exception" on the form; Payroll will do a manual adjustment. 2) Yes once the adjustment is filed and approved before the cutoff, it's treated as scheduled and not subject to the unscheduled PTO blackout.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout for unscheduled PTO = 2026-12-24 to 2026-12-31 UTC. Exceptions require manager + People Ops. Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/year-end-policy

danielle: What about PTO donations? Could Luca receive donated hours so hes not moving the holiday date?

pranav: Donation program is limited to hardship/medical cases and quarterly windows. We don't allow donations for schedule convenience.

recruiting-bot: Noted. Recruiting coverage requested: 2026-12-29 panel for candidate #452. Tagging interview backup list.

sophie: If Recruiting needs a backup, please update calendar invites and the shared rota. Also add a short line in the Time-off Adjustment form under coverage_plan: "Recruiting coverage: xxx covers panel".

danielle: Filed the adjustment (submitted 2509876550) and attached manager approval. Marking the rota now. Thanks everyone.

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-5178 (holiday swap for interview coverage). Assigned: Pranav.
